site.ogDescription: Peer-to-peer sankayan a si fati ka tonton bondoy yereyere taarey gaa. Server ize si no. Naane folla kaŋ ga hasara si no.

hero.subtitle: Peer-to-peer sankayan zamana taji
hero.description: Ka tonton bondoy yereyere taarey gaa. Server ize si no. Naane folla kaŋ ga hasara si no.

about.title: A boŋ
about.intro: {project} ya zamana taji peer-to-peer sankayan tonton, kaŋ ga tonton bondoy yereyere taarey gaa. A ga goy ga sambu nooyaŋ ga laaba kayna nda fati nya kaŋ si fati ka kar a kulu, ga teeyandi kaŋ sankayan goyey ga kayna nda goy ga laaba si fati no kaŋ ga sanno koy. Goy wone ya open source no, kaŋ wofu {license} cire.

decentralized.title: Sare kulu si fati ka kar
decentralized.description: Server ize si no, naane folla kaŋ ga hasara si no. Goyzey ga jine bara nda nooru sankay tan ngey nda care game ra, ga si laakal daŋ index ize, tracker walaa database boŋ.

accessControl.title: Cabi gaay kayna
accessControl.description: Boro kulu ga hin nga boŋ sare tee nda nga boŋ asariyey ka mana hayyaŋ. Sare kulu ra, goyzey nyaŋey go: nooru koy, hizu, taanandiko, hin sankayko, ga ka galmandiko. Ni ga boro kaŋ ga hin ka nooru taanandi, ga sankaykoy daŋ ga zumandi ka cabi-cabi tee.

ui.title: Goyze cabi sumey beeri
ui.description: Mediakpaay cabi kaŋ ga jin ga ga laaba bondoy taji nda taasenoŋ kaarukaarey, televizionyo nda telephone-yo se. Cabi-cabi gaa kayna nda kibordi, suuru, gamepad walaa diraw teebandiko. Goyze beerey ga hin ka goy zumbu mate kaŋ headless data server kommandiko cabi gaa.

dataFormat.title: Sankay alboro ga hin ka caw
dataFormat.description: LISH sankay heeyandiyaŋey ga tonton JSON gaa, kaŋ ga te a kayna ka tee, ka caw ga ka faham. Ni nooru sankay nda metadata kaayniyaŋ kaŋ boro kulu ga hin ka cabi.

security.title: Boŋ tugu nda baani
security.description: Peer-to-peer ifo-ifo kulu ga tugu, kaŋ ga teeyandi ni sankayey ga goro tugu boŋ ka diraw. Goyzey ga hin ka tugu VPN banda ga boŋ tugu se. {project} ga ni boŋ tugu sambu nga taasenoŋ ra.

crossPlatform.title: Bondoy taji kulu boŋ
crossPlatform.description: Goy ga goro Windows, Linux nda macOS se. A goy bondoy kaŋ ni ga ba boŋ.

download.title: Zumandi
download.description: {project} sambu ni bondoy se. Zumandi kulu mana hayyaŋ no nda open source no.

macos.title: Bayrandi hima macOS goyzey se:
macos.intro: macOS Gatekeeper ga goyey kaŋ si signé walaa notarisé kaŋ i zumandi internet ra daabu nda {error} taali.
